---
description: Diagnose and fix a bug through evidence, root-cause analysis, regression testing, and validation.
---
Diagnose this Bastak School bug before editing. Read `AGENTS.md`, use Graphify when available, reproduce or trace the failure, isolate the root cause, and verify the hypothesis. For UI/API issues trace through the shared contract and server-side capability/organization boundary; do not mistake Admin visibility for authorization. Preserve `/api/v2`, CMB boundaries, shared Admin/Student routing, and compatibility-only identifiers. Add a regression test when practical, implement the smallest fix, run targeted validation and relevant surrounding checks, then explain the root cause, changed files, and any browser/deployment gap.
